Volvo is bringing Apple Music to over 2 million cars via an over-the-air (OTA) update to its infotainment systems. Here's what you need to know.

Volvo Cars adds Apple Music integration via OTA update

Volvo has announced that it will be adding Apple Music to the infotainment systems of several models via an over-the-air update, according to a report by Exame (via MacMagazine).

According to a press release on the carmaker's website, "This software update will apply to the Volvo EX90, ES90, XC90, S90, V90, XC60, S60, V60, XC40, EX40, and EC40 model year 2020 and later." The release added, "Actual rollout timing may vary by model."

To celebrate this integration, eligible Volvo customers who have never used Apple Music before will get a free three-month trial, while returning customers who have been off Apple Music for at least a month will get two months free.

In addition to standard Apple Music playback, the Volvo EX60, EX90, and ES90 equipped with the optional Bowers & Wilkins sound system will support spatial audio with Dolby Atmos. The new EX60, which begins deliveries this summer, will also feature Apple Music built in natively.

Volvo says the offer for up to three months of free Apple Music will be available through July 6, 2027. For Volvo's full announcement, click here.

Apple Music requires a valid subscription. It costs $11.99 per month and is available with one month of free service.
